description_en: Calls the CreateVcoRouteEntry operation to add a destination route entry to an IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用CreateVcoRouteEntry接口为IPsec连接添加目的路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-vco-route-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --route-dest 192.168.10.0/24 --weight 100 --next-hop vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVcoRouteEntry

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route entry
parameters.help_zh: 目的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en:
The weight of the destination route entry. Valid values:

0: low priority.
100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
目的路由条目的权重值。取值：

0：表示低优先级。
100：表示高优先级
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the destination route entry
parameters.help_zh: 目的路由条目的下一跳
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en: The description of the destination route entry
parameters.help_zh: 目的路由条目的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to Ipsec (default), which specifies the IPsec tunneling protocol
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议。仅取值：Ipsec（默认值），表示IPsec隧道协议
parameters.name: overlay_mode

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建路由。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the destination route entry was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX timestamp format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to the time when the destination route entry was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建目的路由条目的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建目的路由条目时的总时长

Description.description_en: The description of the destination route entry
Description.description_zh: 目的路由条目的描述信息

NextHop.description_en: The next hop of the destination route entry
NextHop.description_zh: 目的路由条目的下一跳

OverlayMode.description_en:
The tunneling protocol.

The value is Ipsec, which specifies the IPsec tunneling protocol
OverlayMode.description_zh:
隧道协议。

仅取值：Ipsec，表示IPsec隧道协议

RouteDest.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route entry
RouteDest.description_zh: 目的路由条目的目标网段

State.description_en:
The publish status of the destination route entry.

The value is published, which indicates that the route entry is published to the transit router instance
State.description_zh:
目的路由条目的发布状态。

仅取值：published，表示当前路由条目已发布至转发路由器实例中

VpnConnectionId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the destination route entry.

0: low priority.
100: high priority
Weight.description_zh:
目的路由条目的权重值。

0：表示低优先级。
100：表示高优先级
